subject: science

student_question_bikol: Tano ta nahuhulog an mga bagay?
english_explanation: Earth's gravity pulls objects downward.
english_analogy: When you let go of a ball, it falls toward the ground.
bikol_explanation: An grabidad kan daga nagbubutong nin mga bagay pababa.
bikol_analogy: Kun binutasan mo an sarong bola, ini nahuhulog pasiring sa daga.

subject: science
review_note: User confirmed speaker review of this source file; regional variety not specified.
student_question_bikol: Paano naggigibo nin kakanon an mga tinanom?
english_explanation: Plants use sunlight, water, and carbon dioxide to make sugar for energy and growth.
english_analogy: Think of a leaf as a tiny food-making place.
bikol_explanation: An mga tinanom naggagamit nin liwanag kan saldang, tubig, asin carbon dioxide tanganing makagibo nin asukar para sa enerhiya asin pagtalubo.
bikol_analogy: Isipon an sarong dahon bilang sarong sadit na lugar nin paggibo nin kakanon.

subject: science
review_note: User confirmed speaker review of this source file; regional variety not specified.
student_question_bikol: Tano ta natunaw an yelo?
english_explanation: Ice melts when it takes in heat from its surroundings.
english_analogy: An ice cube left on a table slowly becomes liquid water.
bikol_explanation: An yelo natunaw kun ini nagkukua nin init hale sa palibot kaini.
bikol_analogy: An yelo na nawalat sa lamesa luway-luway na nagigin likidong tubig.

subject: science
review_note: User confirmed speaker review of this source file; regional variety not specified.
student_question_bikol: Saen minaduman an sarong laboy?
english_explanation: Heat turns some liquid water into water vapor that mixes with the air.
english_analogy: That is why a puddle can disappear even when nobody wipes it up.
bikol_explanation: An init ginigibo an nagkapirang likidong tubig na magin alisngaw nin tubig na naghahalo sa aire.
bikol_analogy: Iyan an dahilan kun tano ta an sarong laboy puedeng mawara dawa mayo nin siisay man na nagpupunas kaiyan.

subject: science
review_note: User confirmed speaker review of this source file; regional variety not specified.
student_question_bikol: Tano ta nag-uuran?
english_explanation: Water vapor cools and forms tiny drops in clouds.
english_analogy: When enough drops come together and become heavy, they fall as rain.
bikol_explanation: An alisngaw nin tubig naglilipot asin nagpoporma nin saradit na turo sa mga panganoron.
bikol_analogy: Kun an igo na mga turo magkasararo asin nagigin magabat, sinda nahuhulog bilang uran.

subject: science
review_note: User confirmed speaker review of this source file; regional variety not specified.
student_question_bikol: Tano ta nangyayari an mga linog?
english_explanation: Large pieces of Earth's outer layer can suddenly slip along a fault.
english_analogy: That movement sends energy through the ground and makes it shake.
bikol_explanation: An darakulang pidaso kan panluwas na layer kan Kinaban puedeng biglang mag-isol sa sarong fault.
bikol_analogy: An hiro na iyan nagpapadara nin enerhiya sa daga asin nagpapayugyog kaiyan.

subject: science
review_note: User confirmed speaker review of this source file; regional variety not specified.
student_question_bikol: Tano ta nagpuputok an mga bulkan?
english_explanation: Hot melted rock and gas can build pressure beneath the ground.
english_analogy: When they escape through a volcano, an eruption happens.
bikol_explanation: An mainit na natunaw na gapo asin gas pwedeng magbilog nin presyon sa irarom kan daga.
bikol_analogy: Kun sinda nakadulag sa paagi nin sarong bulkan, nangyayari an sarong pagtuga.

subject: science
review_note: User confirmed speaker review of this source file; regional variety not specified.
student_question_en: Why does a rolling ball stop?
student_question_bikol: Tano ta minaontok an nagliligid na bola?
english_explanation: Friction between the ball and the ground slows it down.
english_analogy: A ball usually rolls farther on a smooth floor than on rough grass.
bikol_explanation: An pag-iriwal kan bola asin kan daga nagpapaluway kaini.
bikol_analogy: An bola parati mas harayo an pagligid sa sarong makinis na salog kisa sa magaspang na doot.

subject: science
review_note: User confirmed speaker review of this source file; regional variety not specified.
student_question_bikol: Ano an pwersa?
english_explanation: A force is a push or a pull that can change how something moves.
english_analogy: Pushing a chair across the room is one example.
bikol_explanation: An pwersa sarong pagtulod o pagguyod na pwedeng magbago kan paghiro kan sarong bagay.
bikol_analogy: An pagtulod nin tukawan sa ibong kan kwarto sarong halimbawa.

subject: science
review_note: User confirmed speaker review of this source file; regional variety not specified.
student_question_bikol: Ano an enerhiya?
english_explanation: Energy is what allows things to move, heat up, or change.
english_analogy: Your body gets energy from food when you run or play.
bikol_explanation: An enerhiya iyo an nagtutugot sa mga bagay na maghiro, mag-init, o magbago.
bikol_analogy: An saimong hawak nakakakua nin enerhiya hale sa kakanon kun ika nagdadalagan o nagtutugtog

subject: math
review_note: User confirmed speaker review of this source file; regional variety not specified.
student_question_bikol: Ano an boot sabihon kan kabanga?
english_explanation: One-half is one of two equal parts of a whole.
english_analogy: If you divide one banana equally between two people, each gets one-half.
bikol_explanation: An kabanga saro sa duwang pantay na parte kan sarong kabilogan.
bikol_analogy: Kun babangaon mo nin pantay an sarong saging sa duwang tawo, an lambang saro magkakaigwa nin kabanga.

subject: math
review_note: User confirmed speaker review of this source file; regional variety not specified.
student_question_en: Why are two-fourths and one-half equal?
student_question_bikol: Tano ta pantay an duwang-kaapat asin kabanga?
english_explanation: Two of four equal pieces make the same amount as one of two equal pieces.
english_analogy: Imagine cutting the same sandwich into two pieces, then cutting each piece in half again.
bikol_explanation: Duwa sa apat na pantay na pidaso an parehong kantidad kan saro sa duwang pantay na pidaso.
bikol_analogy: Imahinara na pinutol an parehong sandwich sa duwang pidaso, dangan pinutol giraray an lambang pidaso sa kabanga.

subject: math
review_note: User confirmed speaker review of this source file; regional variety not specified.
student_question_bikol: Ano an boot sabihon kan pagpadakol?
english_explanation: Multiplication can count equal groups quickly.
english_analogy: Three bags with two oranges in each bag contain six oranges altogether.
bikol_explanation: An pagpadakol makakabilang nin pantay na mga grupo nin marikas.
bikol_analogy: An tolong bag na may duwang kahel sa lambang bag igwa nin anom na kahel sa kagabsan.

subject: math
review_note: User confirmed speaker review of this source file; regional variety not specified.
student_question_bikol: Ano an boot sabihon kan pagkabaranga?
english_explanation: Division can mean sharing equally.
english_analogy: If six pencils are shared among three students, each student gets two pencils.
bikol_explanation: An pagkabaranga puedeng mangahulogan nin pantay-pantay na paghiras.
bikol_analogy: Kun an anom na lapis ipag-iribahan sa tolong estudyante, an lambang estudyante magkakaigwa nin duwang lapis.

subject: math
review_note: User confirmed speaker review of this source file; regional variety not specified.
student_question_bikol: Ano an perimeter?
english_explanation: Perimeter is the distance around the edge of a shape.
english_analogy: You could measure the perimeter of a garden by walking along its boundary.
bikol_explanation: An perimeter iyo an distansya sa palibot kan gilid kan sarong porma.
bikol_analogy: Puede mong sokolon an palibot kan sarong hardin sa paagi nin paglakaw sa linderos kaini.

subject: math
review_note: User confirmed speaker review of this source file; regional variety not specified.
student_question_bikol: Ano an lugar?
english_explanation: Area tells us how much surface a shape covers.
english_analogy: Counting the square tiles that cover a floor is one way to find its area.
bikol_explanation: An hiwas nagsasabi sato kun gurano kadakol na ibabaw an natatahoban kan sarong porma.
bikol_analogy: An pagbilang kan mga kwadradong baldosa na nakatahob sa sarong salog sarong paagi tanganing mahanap an hiwas kaini.

subject: general
review_note: User confirmed speaker review of this source file; regional variety not specified.
student_question_bikol: Ano an dahelan asin epekto?
english_explanation: A cause is why something happens, and an effect is what happens afterward.
english_analogy: Heavy rain can be a cause of a flooded path.
bikol_explanation: An kawsa iyo an kun tano ta nangyayari an sarong bagay, asin an epekto iyo an nangyayari pagkatapos.
bikol_analogy: An makusog na uran pwedeng magin kawsa kan binabaha na agihan.

subject: science
review_note: User confirmed speaker review of this source file; regional variety not specified.
student_question_bikol: Ano an istaran?
english_explanation: A habitat is the place where a living thing finds what it needs to survive.
english_analogy: A pond is a habitat for many fish and insects.
bikol_explanation: An istaran iyo an lugar kun saen an sarong buhay na bagay nakakakua kan saiyang kaipuhan tanganing mabuhay.
bikol_analogy: An lawa istaran kan kadakol na sira asin insekto.

subject: health
review_note: User confirmed speaker review of this source file; regional variety not specified.
student_question_en: Why should we wash our hands with soap?
student_question_bikol: Tano ta dapat kitang maghanaw nin kamot gamit an sabon?
english_explanation: Soap and water help remove germs and dirt from our hands.
english_analogy: Washing before eating lowers the chance of carrying those germs into our food.
bikol_explanation: An sabon asin tubig nakakatabang na mahale an mga mikrobyo asin ati sa satong mga kamot.
bikol_analogy: An paghugas bago magkakan nagpapababa kan tsansa na magdara kan mga mikrobyo sa satong kakanon.

subject: science
review_note: User confirmed speaker review of this source file; regional variety not specified.
student_question_bikol: Tano ta minalataw an sarong anino?
english_explanation: A shadow forms when an object blocks light.
english_analogy: Your body can make a shadow on the ground when sunlight shines behind you.
bikol_explanation: An anino napoporma kun an sarong bagay nag-uulang sa liwanag.
bikol_analogy: An saimong hawak pwedeng maggibo nin anino sa daga kun an liwanag kan saldang nagsisirang sa likod mo.
